parole.testo: Inherited from Ottoman Turkish تاصمه (tasma, “strap”), from Proto-Common Turkic *tasma (“leash, strap”). Cognate with Bashkir таҫма (taśma), Kazakh таспа (taspa), Azerbaijani tasma, Turkmen tasma, Kumyk тасма (tasma), etc. Russian тесьма́ (tesʹmá), Polish taśma and Georgian თასმა (tasma) are Turkic
